title: A September Picnic
setting: A sunny park with green grass in September.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

sentences.en: Mia and Ben begin a picnic in September.
sentences.zh: 九月，米娅和本开始野餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) spread a picnic blanket on green grass in a park with a few early autumn leaves.

sentences.narration: Mia and Ben spread a picnic blanket on green grass in a park with a few early autumn leaves.

sentence_targets.en: The month after August and before October.
a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to start happening or start doing something

sentences.en: Mia brings forty small chocolates and cool drinks.
sentences.zh: 米娅带来了四十块小巧克力和清凉的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) opens a box full of small chocolates next to cold drinks on the blanket.

sentence_targets.en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way

sentences.zh: 本看见草地中间有个东西。

sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) look curiously at a small animal shape half hidden in the grass.

sentences.en: It is a puppy the size of a shoe.
sentences.zh: 那是一只只有鞋子大小的小狗。
